data.name: Ulaima
data.long_meaning: The one who nourishes and guides the companions of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh)
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of guidance and wisdom for others

in_arabic.name: عُلَيماء
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم عُلَيماء مشتق من العلم، ويعني في اللغة العربية العلماء أو الحكماء، وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم عدة مرات، ويعتبر من الأسماء ذات الدلالة العميقة في الثقافة الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: علماء
in_urdu.meaning: علماء کا مطلب ہے عقلمند یا علم والے
in_urdu.long_meaning: علماء نام عربی زبان کی 'علم' جڑ سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے علم یا سمجھ. یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں خاصی اہمیت رکھتا ہے، اور علمی اور فکری فضائل کے حامل افراد کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے.

in_hindi.name: उलैमा
in_hindi.meaning: उलैमा का अर्थ है विद्वान या ज्ञानी
in_hindi.long_meaning: उलैमा नाम अरबी भाषा की 'इल्म' जड़ से निकला है, जिसका अर्थ है ज्ञान या समझ. यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में विशेष महत्व रखता है, और विद्वानों और बुद्धिमान व्यक्तियों के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है.

in_pashto.name: علماء
in_pashto.meaning: علماء د پوهانو یا دانا کسانو معنی
in_pashto.long_meaning: علماء نوم د عربی ژبې د 'علم' ريښې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې د پوهې یا پوهانو څخه ده. دا نوم د افغان او پښتني دودیزو ارزښتونو کې ځانګړی اهمیت لري.

in_english.name: Ulaima
in_english.meaning: Learned ones, scholars, or wise individuals
in_english.long_meaning: The name Ulaima originates from the Arabic root 'ilm,' meaning knowledge. It signifies scholars, learned ones, or wise individuals in Islamic tradition. This name holds spiritual significance, representing pursuit of knowledge and wisdom. Historically, it has been used to denote individuals of great intellectual and spiritual stature within Muslim communities.

data.cultural_impact: The name Ulaima holds a significant cultural impact within the Islamic community, as it serves as a reminder of the Prophet Muhammad’s companions and their roles in spreading and preserving the teachings of Islam. The term "Ulaima" can be translated to mean "nourisher" or "guide," two essential qualities of a Prophet's companions. In this sense, the name carries the historical and socio-cultural significance of recognizing and celebrating the contributions of the early Muslims who devoted their lives to establishing and solidifying the foundations of the Muslim community.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Ulaima also holds deep spiritual significance, as it highlights the important bond between the companions of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and their continuous dedication to upholding and preserving the teachings of Islam. As a spiritual name, Ulaima symbolizes the enduring strength and resilience of the believers’ faith and their unwavering commitment to their spiritual journey. It also emphasizes the importance of community and unity in the face of adversity, as the Prophet’s companions provided crucial support and guidance to one another throughout their shared experience. Overall, the name Ulaima represents a strong sense of spiritual nourishment and guidance, both for the individual and for the broader Muslim community.

historical_references.reference: Ulaima bint Al-Harith ibn Abdul-Muttalib, was the wife of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and the mother of his two sons, Ibrahim and Al-Qasim.
historical_references.context: Ulaima was a member of the Banu Abdul-Dar clan of the Quraysh tribe, and was a respected and noblewoman in Mecca before her marriage to the Prophet (pbuh).
